functions.name: AppendDecode
functions.summary: AppendDecode appends the hexadecimally decoded src to dst and returns the extended buffer. If the input is malformed, it returns the partially decoded src and an error.

functions.name: AppendEncode
functions.summary: AppendEncode appends the hexadecimally encoded src to dst and returns the extended buffer.

functions.name: Decode
functions.summary: Decode decodes src into [DecodedLen](len(src)) bytes, returning the actual number of bytes written to dst.

functions.name: DecodeString
functions.summary: DecodeString returns the bytes represented by the hexadecimal string s.

functions.name: DecodedLen
functions.summary: DecodedLen returns the length of a decoding of x source bytes. Specifically, it returns x / 2.
functions.signature: func DecodedLen(x int) int { return x / 2 }

lines: func DecodedLen(x int) int { return x / 2 }

functions.name: Dump
functions.summary: Dump returns a string that contains a hex dump of the given data. The format of the hex dump matches the output of `hexdump -C` on the command line.

functions.name: Dumper
functions.summary: Dumper returns a [io.WriteCloser] that writes a hex dump of all written data to w. The format of the dump matches the output of `hexdump -C` on the command line.

functions.name: Encode
functions.summary: Encode encodes src into [EncodedLen](len(src)) bytes of dst. As a convenience, it returns the number of bytes written to dst, but this value is always [EncodedLen](len(src)). Encode implements hexadecimal encoding.

functions.name: EncodeToString
functions.summary: EncodeToString returns the hexadecimal encoding of src.

functions.name: EncodedLen
functions.summary: EncodedLen returns the length of an encoding of n source bytes. Specifically, it returns n * 2.
functions.signature: func EncodedLen(n int) int { return n * 2 }

lines: func EncodedLen(n int) int { return n * 2 }

functions.name: NewDecoder
functions.summary: NewDecoder returns an [io.Reader] that decodes hexadecimal characters from r. NewDecoder expects that r contain only an even number of hexadecimal characters.

functions.name: NewEncoder
functions.summary: NewEncoder returns an [io.Writer] that writes lowercase hexadecimal characters to w.
